_readme: Interim cabinet parameters (mm). MEASURE = placeholder until measured on the team's own boards with calipers; the defaults are round numbers or, where a source is named, a published drawing of a similar board, NOT measurements of our boards. DESIGN = a design choice to tune on a test print. Edit 'value' only, then re-run: freecadcmd build_interim_cabinet.py

PERF_W.how: perfboard outline along the box width (x), the largest board of the stack

PERF_L.how: perfboard outline along the box length (y)

UNDER_H.how: tallest solder joint / wire below the perfboard

STACK_H.how: tallest point above the perfboard top (dev board on its headers, OLED, wires)

ESP_L.how: dev board length (USB end to antenna end)
ESP_L.source: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4 dimension drawing (dl.espressif.com/dl/schematics/esp32_devkitc_v4_dimensions.pdf). The team's board looks like a 30-pin DOIT-style board in media/photos/1.jpg - measure it

ESP_X0.how: perfboard -x edge to the dev board's antenna-end edge

ESP_Y0.how: perfboard -y edge to the dev board's near long edge

ESP_PCB_Z_ABOVE_PERF.how: perfboard top to the dev board underside (header/socket height)

USB_POS_Y.how: perfboard -y edge to the centre of the dev board's USB receptacle
USB_POS_Y.source: PLACEHOLDER - measure (the DevKitC drawing shows the USB near the centre of the short edge but does not dimension it)

USB_Z_ABOVE_PERF.how: perfboard top to the centre of the USB receptacle

USB_OPEN_W.how: width of your USB cable's plug overmould + 1 mm

USB_OPEN_H.how: height of your USB cable's plug overmould + 1 mm

OLED_FITTED.how: false = lid without a window (box for a build with no OLED)

OLED_AA_W.source: probots.co.in 1.3 inch SH1106 listing, 'Approx. 29.4mm x 14.7mm' - measure your module

OLED_AA_CX.how: perfboard -x edge to the centre of the OLED active area

OLED_AA_CY.how: perfboard -y edge to the centre of the OLED active area

OLED_MOD_W.how: OLED module PCB width (only used for the dummy block)

OLED_MOD_L.how: OLED module PCB length (dummy block only)

OLED_PCB_Z_ABOVE_PERF.how: perfboard top to the OLED module PCB underside

MPU_W.how: GY-521 MPU6050 breakout width (dummy block only)

CABLE_D.how: insole cable bundle diameter where it leaves the box

CABLE_POS_Y.how: perfboard -y edge to where the cable crosses the -x wall
CABLE_POS_Y.source: PLACEHOLDER - measure (photo 1.jpg shows it between the OLED and the ESP32)

CABLE_Z_ABOVE_PERF.how: perfboard top to the cable centre at the wall

PANE_T.how: thickness of the clear acrylic offcut glued behind the OLED window

LID_HOLES.how: optional lid holes [[x, y], ...] in perfboard coordinates, e.g. over the GPIO2 status LED or the EN/BOOT buttons

TOP_CLEAR.note: tallest part to the lid underside

PILOT_D.note: M3 thread-forming pilot; tune on a test print

PAD.note: corner pads under / clamp posts over the perfboard corners: keep a 4 x 4 mm square at each corner free of parts, top and bottom

STRAP_W.note: same strap as the Rev C pod cradle (PRINT-AND-ASSEMBLY.md section 2); no strap bought yet

CABLE_SQUEEZE.note: lid tongue presses the cable by this much (strain relief)
